description: Token-id prefixes of two exact reasoning loops from a 4-bit MiMo 9B build (Qwen3.5-9B-V26-Distill, MTP depth 2) on 2026-09-22, re-tokenized from the saved text with the Qwen 3.5 tokenizer. Each prefix runs from the first generated token past the point where three whole copies of the cycle are complete.
